summary: From farm to café: the companies KIRA found at each stage of the Vietnamese coffee chain. Bubble size is the number of companies in KIRA's database, or an official estimate where one exists.
method: On 2026-10-07 KIRA re-opened the source page for every row. "Source checked" means a page we opened supports that the company exists and works at that stage; it does not confirm every field (province and ownership are often not on the page). "Not checked" means we could not open any supporting page.
Counts are companies KIRA found, not the whole market. Smallholder farmers, small dealers and independent cafés are mostly absent because they have no findable legal entity.

Tax IDs are shown as verified only when a page we opened shows the company name next to the number. Other numbers found in search results are listed as unverified candidates to re-check against the business registry.

Ring colour needs a sourced concentration figure. Almost no company has a sourced capital figure, so rings use stage-level shares from industry statistics where they exist (export, retail) and stay grey elsewhere.
